sharedRules.name: Thrill Seekers
sharedRules.description:
If your Army Faction is EMPERORS CHILDREN:
  -> Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [ASSAULT].
  -> The unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Advanced.
  -> The unit is eligible to shoot in a turn in which it Fell Back.
  -> The unit is eligible to declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back.
  If the unit advanced this turn or if the unit fell back this turn:
    -> The unit cannot target enemy units with ranged attacks if the target unit was engaged with this unit at the start of the turn.
    -> The unit cannot target enemy units with a charge if the target unit was engaged with this unit at the start of the turn.
  If the unit advanced this turn or if the unit fell back this turn:
    -> The unit cannot target enemy units with ranged attacks if a unit other than this unit has selected the target unit as a target this phase or a unit other than this unit has selected the target unit as a charge target this phase.
    -> The unit cannot target enemy units with a charge if a unit other than this unit has selected the target unit as a target this phase or a unit other than this unit has selected the target unit as a charge target this phase.

rules.name: Internal Rivalries
rules.description: If the unit has the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN keyword, if the unit has the CHARACTER keyword, the unit ignores any modifiers to its characteristics; the unit ignores any modifiers to its Advance rolls; the unit ignores any modifiers to its Charge rolls; you can re-roll a failed Wound roll.

rules.description: If the unit has the EMPEROR'S CHILDREN keyword, while the unit is within 6" of a friendly LEGIONS OF EXCESS unit, the unit's weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Exquisite Swordsmanship
rules.description:
When a friendly unit is selected to fight (the triggering unit must have EMPEROR'S CHILDREN), if the triggering unit charged this turn, until that unit finishes resolving its attacks:
  Select one of the following:
    - Melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit gain [LETHAL HITS].
    - Melee weapons equipped by the triggering unit gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].

rules.name: Mechanised Murder
rules.description:
If the attacking unit has the TRANSPORT keyword or if the attacking unit disembarked from a Transport this turn:
  -> You can re-roll a Hit roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models.
  -> You can re-roll a Wound roll of 1 for attacks made by all friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN models.

rules.name: Quicksilver Grace
rules.description: You can re-roll the Advance roll for all friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units.

rules.name: Sensational Performance
rules.description:
All friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units gain the Sensational Performance ability.
-> When the unit is selected to fight, if the unit charged this turn, you may use this ability, until the end of the phase:
  -> The unit cannot target enemy units with attacks if the target unit was engaged with this unit at the start of the turn.
  -> The unit cannot target enemy units with attacks if a unit other than this unit has selected the target unit as a target this phase.
  -> Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
  -> Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR'S CHILDREN.

rules.name: Pledges to the Dark Prince
rules.description:
-> At the start of the battle round: while a friendly model that is the Warlord is on the battlefield, declare a number as your pledge.
-> At the end of the battle round:
  -> If you destroyed at least as many enemy units this battle round as your pledge, you gain a number of Pact points equal to your pledge.
  -> Unless you destroyed at least as many enemy units this battle round as your pledge, friendly models that are the Warlord suffer D3 mortal wounds.
All friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units gain the following rules:
  -> While you have 1+ pact points, you can re-roll a Hit roll of 1.
  -> While you have 3+ pact points, you can re-roll a Wound roll of 1.
  -> While you have 5+ pact points, melee weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [LETHAL HITS] and [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
  -> While you have 7+ pact points, the unit scores Critical Hits on Hit rolls of 5+.

When the unit disembarks from a Transport, you may use this ability, until the end of the turn:
  -> You can re-roll the Charge roll.
  -> Enemy units cannot target the unit with the Fire Overwatch Stratagem.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, INFANTRY.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After an enemy unit shoots, you may use this ability, once per turn per model, during the Shooting phase, in the opponent's turn, until the end of the phase:
  -> Select one friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit within 9" of this model that was hit by an attack made by the triggering unit during its just-finished shooting sequence, binding it as outer:
    -> Select one friendly TRANSPORT unit if the bound outer is wholly within 6" of the unit and the bound outer is able to embark within that Transport, binding it as inner: the bound outer is eligible to embark into the bound inner.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, INFANTRY.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After a saving throw made for a friendly model is failed (the triggering model must have EMPEROR'S CHILDREN and VEHICLE), you may use this ability, once per battle round per model, while the triggering model is within 6" of this model, each time an attack is allocated to the triggering model, change the Damage of that attack to 0.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, INFANTRY.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While the target unit is below its starting strength:
  -> The unit gets +1 to Hit rolls.
  -> While the target unit is below half strength, the unit gets +1 to Wound rolls.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Against melee attacks, when the attack's S is more than the target's T, the attacking unit gets -1 to Wound rolls.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After deployment, you may use this ability:
  -> Select up to 2 friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units:
    -> For each selected unit:
      -> That unit can be set up on the battlefield.
      -> That unit can be placed into Strategic Reserves, ignoring any limits on units in Strategic Reserves.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
When the unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move:
  -> The triggering unit can move over enemy models as though they were not there.
  -> This model is eligible to move even if it is within Engagement Range of enemy units.
  -> This model cannot end a move within Engagement Range of any enemy unit, during its Normal, Advance and Fall Back moves.
  -> The unit automatically passes Desperate Escape tests.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
You can: While making melee attacks:
  -> The unit ignores any modifiers to its Weapon Skill characteristics with melee weapons.
  -> The unit ignores any modifiers to its Hit and Wound rolls with melee weapons.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1 to this model's Move characteristic.
Applies to: units with LORD EXULTANT.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of the Fight phase, you may use this ability:
  -> Select one enemy unit if the selected unit is within Engagement Range of this model: that unit must take a Battle-shock test, applying -1 to that test.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Add 1 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, DAEMON PRINCE.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
For the rest of the battle:
  -> This model takes a Leadership test (2D6, passing on its current Leadership or higher); if passed, this model is set up again as close as possible to where it was destroyed with D6 wounds remaining.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
While this model is leading a unit:
  -> Improve the unit's Leadership characteristic by 1.
  -> Improve the unit's Objective Control characteristic by 1.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
At the start of your Shooting phase, until the end of the phase:
  -> Select one enemy unit if the selected unit is within 12" of this model and the selected unit is visible to this model:
    -> While the selected unit is Battle-shocked, that unit must take a Leadership test, applying -2 to that test.
    -> If the triggering leadership roll was a failure, that unit suffers 3 mortal wounds.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
After a Hit roll is made, you may use this ability or after a Wound roll is made, you may use this ability or after a saving throw is made, you may use this ability, once per turn per model, while the unit is not Battle-shocked:
  Select one of the following:
    - One of the unit's Hit rolls counts as 6.
    - One of the unit's Wound rolls counts as 6.
    - One of the unit's saving throw rolls counts as 6.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
This model gains the Deep Strike ability.
Ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit gain [IGNORES COVER].
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, LORD KAKOPHONIST.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
The unit's weapons gain [SUSTAINED HITS 1].
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, TERMINATOR SQUAD.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Improve the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by this model by 1.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, LORD EXULTANT.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of ranged weapons equipped by models in this unit by 1.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, LORD EXULTANT.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Add 2 to the unit's Move characteristic.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, FLAWLESS BLADES.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Your opponent cannot target the unit with Overwatch.
Applies to: units with EMPEROR’S CHILDREN, FLAWLESS BLADES.
